end.summary:
Practised representing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi made 2 attempts; neither was unaided correct.
They repeatedly counted the bundle as one when finding the total.
Saanvi reported that the picture was not visible, and the mix-up remained at the last response.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised describing numbers as one bundle of ten plus loose ones. They identified a bundle and loose sticks, but continued counting the bundle as one rather than ten; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, tie or group 10 small objects together, add a few loose objects, and ask, “How many in all?” while saying “ten and some more.”
